terms.meaning: a switch that shows one of several panels at a time
a rule that keeps only the items matching a search
a layout that changes with the width of the screen

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in React state, icons, the store, the editor and the graph. This section only sets up the file.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond normal file setup.

sections.name: NotesView (part 1)
sections.title: Selection, search and new note logic
sections.what: Remembers the chosen note and the search text, and works out which note is shown. Filters notes by title or tag, ignoring letter case. Creating a note adds a fixed title and starter body in the general folder.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps search and selection in one place so the list and the editor stay in step.
sections.watch_out: Search only checks titles and tags, so text inside a note body will not be found.

sections.name: NotesView (part 2)
sections.title: Mobile tabs and list header
sections.what: Shows three buttons on small screens for the list, the editor and the graph, with the current note title on the editor button. Shows the list header with its title and a create button. On phones, the list is hidden while the editor tab is open.
sections.why: Likely reason: a phone has room for only one panel at a time.

sections.name: NotesView (part 3)
sections.title: Search box, note list and graph
sections.what: Shows the search field and a scrollable list of matching notes, each with its title and tags. Clicking a note selects it and, on phones, opens the editor. The knowledge graph sits below the list and can also select a note.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps browsing and linking together in one column.
sections.watch_out: Selecting a note from the graph does not switch the phone tab, so on phones the editor may not appear straight away.

sections.name: NotesView (part 4)
sections.title: Editor panel and empty state
sections.what: Shows the editor for the chosen note on the right, wired to update and delete that note. If no note is chosen, shows a message asking the user to select or create one.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the editor separate so the list logic stays simple.
sections.watch_out: Deleting the open note happens immediately with no confirmation.

summary: The main Notes page: a searchable note list on one side, the editor and graph on the other, with a tab layout on small screens.
purpose: Lets the user find, create, open and edit notes, and see how they relate.
why: Likely reason: a split layout on wide screens and a tab view on phones, so one page works on both.
how: Keeps the chosen note and search text in memory. Filters the list by title or tag. The plus button adds a note with starter text. On small screens, tabs switch between the list, the editor and the graph, and picking a note on a phone opens the editor. The right side renders the editor for the chosen note.
inputs: Notes from the shared store, the search text typed by the user, clicks on the list, the create button and the tabs.
outputs: New notes and edits saved to the store, and the displayed list and chosen note.
risks: Search does not look inside note bodies. Deleting a note has no confirmation. If the chosen note is deleted, the screen falls back to the first note. The starter text contains a fixed example link.
debug: If a note is missing from the list, check the search text and the store. If the editor is blank, check the selected note id and the notes list. If the phone layout is wrong, check the tab state.
